//: Shared Claude Code settings. Committed to the repo, so every clone gets
them — nobody configures anything per machine.
The hooks below are what capture agent work done LOCALLY in VS Code. The
platform dispatches runs on GitHub and therefore sees those completely. It
cannot see a session on someone's laptop unless that session reports in.
These hooks make it report in.
What is sent: who, which branch, which repo, when a session started and
ended, and which files were edited. What is NOT sent: prompts, code
contents, keystrokes, or anything typed. The platform records that an agent
session happened and on what — not what was said inside it.
This is best-effort by design. A determined person can disable it. That is
acceptable, because the durable record is the commit and the PR, which no
hook is required to produce. These hooks add texture; git is the ledger.

hooks.command: curl -sf -m 3 -X POST "$IHELP_PLATFORM_URL/api/agents/local" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"event\":\"start\",\"gh_login\":\"$(git config user.email)\",\"repo\":\"$(basename $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel))\",\"branch\":\"$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)\",\"session\":\"$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID\"}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

curl -sf -m 3 -X POST "$IHELP_PLATFORM_URL/api/agents/local" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"event\":\"stop\",\"gh_login\":\"$(git config user.email)\",\"repo\":\"$(basename $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel))\",\"branch\":\"$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)\",\"session\":\"$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID\",\"files_changed\":$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
